title.en: International Organisations (Immunities and Privileges) (Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency) Order 2002

completenessNote: 全文，共 11 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。其中 1 条为官方正文中标注的已废止条文存根（照录）。

text.en: 1. This Order is the International Organisations (Immunities and Privileges) (Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency) Order 2002.
3. MIGA is an organisation of the nature indicated in section 2(1) of the Act and has the legal capacity of a body corporate.

heading.en: Immunity from suit and legal process

text.en:
4.—(1) MIGA has immunity from any suit and legal process which relates to any personnel matter.
(2) MIGA has immunity from any suit or legal process brought by —
(a)a member of MIGA, an agency of such member, or a person acting for or deriving any claim from such member; or
(b)a State which has ceased to be a member of MIGA or an agency of such State.
(3) The property and assets of MIGA, wherever located and by whomsoever held, are immune from any legal process relating to the seizure, attachment or execution of such property or assets for the purpose of satisfying any judgment or award against MIGA, except in the case of a final judgment or award.
5. MIGA has the like inviolability of its official archives as is accorded in respect of the official archives of an envoy of a foreign sovereign Power accredited to the President.

heading.en: Exemption and relief from certain taxes and rates

text.en: 6. MIGA has the like exemption or relief from taxes and rates, other than import, export or excise duties on any article, as is accorded to a foreign sovereign Power.

heading.en: Exemption from tax on importation of goods

text.en:
7. MIGA has exemption from tax on the importation of —
(a)goods directly imported by it for its official use in Singapore or for exportation; and
(b)any of the publications of MIGA directly imported by it,
subject to compliance with any condition that the Director‑General of Customs may prescribe for the protection of revenue.

heading.en: Immunity and exemptions for high officials

chapter.en: PART 3 OTHER OFFICIALS AND EMPLOYEES OF MIGA

text.en:
10.—(1) Each member of the staff of MIGA enjoys —
(a)immunity from legal process in respect of acts performed by the member in his or her official capacity; and
(b)exemption from taxation on or in respect of salaries, expense allowances and other emoluments paid to him or her by MIGA.
(2) The exemption under sub‑paragraph (1)(b) does not apply to any member of the staff of MIGA who is a citizen or permanent resident of Singapore.

11.—(1) Any immunity or privilege under this Order may be waived by MIGA to such extent and upon such conditions as MIGA may determine, except where the waiver prejudices the interests of MIGA.
(2) Any immunity or privilege under this Order is to be waived by MIGA if MIGA is of the opinion that the immunity or privilege —
(a)impedes the course of justice; and
(b)can be waived without prejudicing the interests of MIGA.
